mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish: conditions are clear around the Military Ridge State Trail with an air quality index of 53. We are currently under a third quarter moon, and our overnight low will hit 67 degrees with no rain predicted for the rest of the night.

The City of Verona remains committed to maintaining our infrastructure by contracting engineering services through AECOM Inc. Detailed reports are presented during regular City Council meetings, with the most recent updates spanning through August 10th of this year.

We have a busy schedule today with Yoga at Insight Wellness, free live music at the Concerts in the Park, and Hop Haus Trivia this evening. Looking ahead, you can enjoy music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee tomorrow, or head to the Capitol Square for the Dane County Farmer's Market this Friday.

Looking at the weekly recap, on July 31st, a traffic stop regarding an equipment violation resulted in the arrest of a 27-year-old woman for O W I, alongside additional citations for suspended registration.
Treat yourself to the Chocolate Caramel Twist at Culver's today. They are open until 10 PM this evening, so you have plenty of time to stop by for a scoop.
